page.overview:
Who is Damien Darkblood?

Damien Darkblood is a supporting character in Invincible, debuting from Season 1 and onwards.

He is a demon detective who pursues justice from others to redeem his own soul and repay a debt. He had worked for the Global Defense Agency and investigated the deaths of the Guardians of the Globe before he was returned to Hell for refusing the cease the investigation as ordered by Cecil Stedman. Following his exile, Damien soon reunited with his family in Hell and put himself in the service of its former ruler, Satan.

When a dangerous threat known as Volcanikka emerged in Hell and threatened to destroy both it as well as the surface world, Damien and his family worked tirelessly with Satan to stop her. However, they were unable to match her overwhelming strength, so Damien aimed to summon Omni-Man to Hell to enlist his services in stopping Volcanikka. Unaware that he had long since left the planet, Damien inadvertently summoned Omni-Man's son, Invincible, instead. Together, they stopped Volcanikka and returned Satan to power in Hell.

Damien was then allowed by Satan to return to the surface world with Invincible, having repaid his debt in-full. Upon his return, Damien was also tasked by Satan to investigate and figure out why Volcanikka aimed to conquer the surface world in the first place.
